title: Handover - On the Road in Norfolk with Lydia
summary: Join Anima account director Lydia on a week of practice visits in Norfolk, learning from the teams delivering care every day.

Lydia has supported hundreds of practices since joining Anima, but she is the first to admit that she learns something new with every visit.


It is super important to us that Anima keeps improving for the healthcare teams and patients that use it every day.


Last month one of our most experienced Account Directors, Lydia, spent a week on the road in Norfolk. Every day she met with Practice Managers and GPs, listened to what was on their minds, answered their questions, and helped them learn more about Anima. This is what she heard.
